b4/host/b4_carto.py.note: the observation cartographer (closed-book: single-bit pairs under one stimulus -> seen cells / presence / no effect seen / context-dependent / unknown; multi-bit pairs counted, never decomposed; no semantic claim), the operator's groups, the v3 draft's shape check, control X (the derangement rule and the shadow isomorphism derived from B3's control-X contract, re-aimed at the eight visible lanes), A0, D and the PRIVILEGED oracle view.

b4/host/b4_engine.py.note: B2's (mu, lambda) = (4, 8), KMAX = 4 engine re-implemented over the FF universe with the execution boundary at every observation: the arms R / F (a seeded probe pass, then frozen; or a given view with its provenance) / O / X, DOMAIN termination (the measured prefix, the pending children, no further draw, observation, score, selection or learning, the generator not rolled back), the ledger with map versions and commitments, generation closes, the holdout once for a completed run. Provenance: the observation source's identity (hypothesis digest and fixture marker, certificate digest) bound into the result and every ledger entry; a given view kept with its provenance chain; a DOMAIN at the holdout keeps the search's champion without a holdout score.

b4/host/b4_execution.py.note: the execution boundary: ObservationPort (observe and the addresses, nothing else), SpyPort, PublicTask, TerminalEvent / Terminated / OtherRefusal, observe_candidate (DOMAIN -> a terminal event with the state before the call; any other refusal by its name). The strict source-identity validator (provenance_findings: hypothesis, mapping and FABRIC fields, exact types, 64-hex digests), SourceRefusal, the finite refusal kinds and raise_refusal.

b4/host/b4_ff_hypothesis.py.note: the behaviour hypothesis loader: load() takes no path, reads the committed file only against the pinned HYPOTHESIS_SHA256, holds the shape (validated enum readings; unknown only in clock_mode's latch context) and re-hashes every named source, always; any other document — a valid copy included — enters through fixture() / fixture_file() and is marked; the decode by equality with clock_mode per storage context and unknown readings reported.

b4/host/b4_ff_mapping.py.note: the certificate mapping of one site, read from the committed certificate against its pinned digest (another file only with its digest given explicitly); address ranges, endpoint existence and site; each token's reading DIRECTION is the class's (every token direct but NOCLKINV, negated) and the row's negated / expected_value / transition must agree with it; the two readings of a shared bit must be complementary; the project's bit readings held to the certificate's specimen pairs.

b4/host/b4_ff_model.py.note: the simulated fabric: configuration + stimulus -> the EXECUTING SIDE's trace under a mapping and a hypothesis passed in separately; the decode and everything derived from it host-only (diagnose / step_diagnostics); validation of the configuration, every step as handed and the init step's context at the entry; a configuration outside the domain refused with the fixed code DOMAIN and no reason (never a specimen, a redraw condition or a map-update signal); fixtures truth / permuted / dropout and seven hypothesis swaps. Every Fabric carries a source descriptor (kind, effect digest, dropout digest and count, seed — digests only) in every trace header.

b4/host/b4_landscape.py.note: the public task generator task-v0.1 (stimulus, mask, target, weights from the landscape seed alone; the all-zero base declared; the holdout stimulus its own derivation) and the scoring (None scores nothing, is counted, never moves the ceiling).

b4/host/b4_replay.py.note: replay as RE-EXECUTION: the engine run again from the declared inputs against a ledger-backed port that serves the recorded observations in order, raises the recorded refusal at its attempt and holds every call to the record; the whole result compared field by field; the authenticity limit stated (the execution sequence is proved, the observations' origin is bound, not re-derived). Validation total and type-exact before any use; refusals re-raised by their finite kind; a malformed record a named finding, an internal error reported as such.

b4/host/b4_rng.py.note: the line's PRNG (xorshift64 over a 32-bit seed, uniform by rejection, partial Fisher-Yates sample) copied from b1_carto.Rng with a state() accessor added; behavioural equality held by b4/tests/test_b4_rng.py by import of the pinned original (read-only).

b4/host/b4_stats.py.note: the four-corner interaction index and its four per-seed outcomes as a pure computation; tau a parameter with no default; every seed in the denominator.

b4/hypothesis/ff_behaviour_v0.2.json.note: status unverified; v0.2: machine-enum readings, clock_mode by storage context (the latch probe's finding), the domain rule, the initialisation event's allowed context, the executing-side / host-only split of the observation context; sources by kind — the vendor's UNISIM models by root + path + sha256 + the lines adopted, the certificate and docs/ff_latch_probe.md by path + sha256, the project's decode assumptions. 0.2.1: the domain_refusal and formal_input blocks.

b4/probes/latch_ginv/build_ff_latch_ginv.note: the LATCH probe's build script reading the derived Verilog, passing GINV as a generic, and reading back every inversion property and every pin of every storage cell

b4/probes/latch_ginv/probe_latch_ginv.py.note: builds the pair main_latch / main_latch_ginv on the mine site with stamps, imports the analysis helpers of scripts/ read-only (named by digest in the report), buckets the full diff, verifies every cell, evaluates the expectation fixed before the build, exports the evidence; any miss archived as it came and exit 2; attempt 2: the cell rule accepts ROUTED and INTRASITE (the owner's follow-up ruling), its own raw and evidence directories, attempt 1 kept

b4/probes/latch_ginv/specimen_ff_latch_g.note: the LATCH probe's specimen family with one parameter GINV applied as IS_G_INVERTED on every LDCE (D1' latch_ginv probe); the original pinned and unchanged

b4/schemas/self_map_v3.schema.json.note: self_map 3.0.0-draft: observation relations, groups, an empty semantic_claims slot, host_verdict null; v2 untouched.

b4/tests/b4_test_fixtures.py.note: the MARKED mechanics hypothesis (the latch's clock bit 0 read as not inverted: a complete domain for exercising mechanics; says nothing about the fabric) and the injecting port.

b4/tests/test_b4_engine.py.note: complete runs under the mechanics fixture; DOMAIN injected at the base, in the probe pass and mid-generation; the formal-hypothesis fact that F's probe pass terminates at the LATCH flip.

b4/tests/test_b4_ff_model.py.note: every expected trace derived by hand from the hypothesis's adopted lines, never by running the model.

b4/tests/test_b4_probe_latch_ginv.py.note: the probe's pure parts without Vivado: per-cell verification, structure comparison, the expectation, the build cache, the recipe's fixed facts and the untouched originals
